title: fix: replace dead Discord invite link
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Replaced 18 broken Discord invite links across the website, Enter (including the Join Discord quest), OpenClaw, and project and package READMEs with the permanent invite discord.gg/k9F7SyTgqn. The previous custom invite, discord.gg/pollinations-ai-885844321461485618, stopped working after the server's custom invite changed; the replacement does not expire or depend on the server's boost level. Bumped @pollinations/sdk to 5.1.0-alpha.16 and polli-cli to 0.1.46 so their npm READMEs carry the corrected link. Server ID-based quest membership checks, the member counter, and the README badge are unchanged.
